label: COMMUNICATION

cover.headline: Talking about *the future* together
cover.sub: Plans, dreams, and money, without the pressure.

points.heading: Start with dreams, not budgets
points.body: Big hopes are easier to talk about than spreadsheets.
points.panel: “If money didn’t matter, what would you love our life to look like?”

points.heading: Pick a relaxed setting
points.body: A walk or a long drive feels lighter than a formal sit-down.
points.panel: Bring it up on your next walk together.

points.heading: Listen for the why
points.body: Behind every goal is a feeling, like safety, freedom, or rest.
points.panel: “What would that give you that you don’t have now?”

points.heading: Find one shared goal
points.body: You don’t need to agree on everything. Start with one thing.
points.panel: “Let’s choose one goal for next year, just us.”

points.heading: Check in again later
points.body: Plans change. A short check-in keeps you on the same page.
points.panel: Put a quarterly “us” talk in your calendar.

close.save: Save this for your next walk together.

caption:
Many couples talk about the week ahead, but rarely about the years ahead.

Talking about your future, including money, doesn’t have to feel like a negotiation. It can be a way to dream together and feel like teammates again. These five steps help you start gently, and keep it going.

Save this for your next walk together, and follow @spotseason for more.
